summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a 6-K closing notice for an automatic-registration public offering of R$500 million of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures (11th issuance, 500,000 units at R$1,000 par) led by BTG Pactual and XP Investimentos, with Vortx as trustee. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The offering closed on July 15, 2026, and received automatic CVM registration on July 27, 2026. No equity, merger, or restructuring elements are present; classification is None.
